# Arduino runtime

The archive contains the upstream source tree for Arduino_TensorFlowLite
2.4.0-ALPHA at commit `7948b85e020470a30a83bf00e10fc43b486bfcba` from
https://github.com/tensorflow/tflite-micro-arduino-examples .
This is the revision checked out in the author's Arduino library directory.
It was exported using Git archive, without repository metadata.
The bundled LICENSE is retained. The archive provides the legacy
`TensorFlowLite.h` and micro-interpreter API expected by the workflow.

Only runtime source, library metadata, AUTHORS, README, and LICENSE are included;
upstream demonstration media and development scripts are omitted.
